description: This file is a PHP source code for the ModuleBuilderController class in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM extension, managing module building, layout editing, package deployment, relationships, fields, labels, and user preferences.

classes.name: ModuleBuilderController
classes.description: Controller class for managing module building, layout editing, package deployment, relationship management, and user preferences within SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM.

methods.name: getModuleTitle
methods.description: Provides the module title based on request parameters.

methods.name: fromModuleBuilder
methods.description: Determines if the request is from Module Builder interface.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles access control and initial processing based on user permissions.

methods.name: action_editLayout
methods.description: Prepares layout editing views based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_ViewTree
methods.description: Returns a tree view for modules or studio.

methods.name: action_SavePackage
methods.description: Saves a module package, handling duplication if necessary.

methods.name: action_DeployPackage
methods.description: Deploys a package, including copying zip files and clearing caches.

methods.name: action_SaveModule
methods.description: Saves module information within a package.

methods.name: action_DeleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a module from a package.

methods.name: action_saveLabels
methods.description: Saves labels for modules or studio views.

methods.name: action_SaveLabel
methods.description: Saves a single label for a module.

methods.name: action_SaveField
methods.description: Saves a custom or standard field, including handling dynamic modules.

methods.name: action_DeleteField
methods.description: Deletes a field from module or studio layouts.

methods.name: DeleteLabel
methods.description: Removes a label from language files.

methods.name: action_SaveAssistantPref
methods.description: Saves user preferences for the assistant.

methods.name: action_get_app_list_string
methods.description: Retrieves app list strings for localization.

methods.name: action_savetablesort
methods.description: Saves user preferences for table sorting.
